correctness.rationale: Definitions fix two directed binary relations F and G as the graphs of two bijections, preventing confusion with unary function symbols. Exhaustive all-pair enumeration n=1..5 proves that the two-variable-definable first-round atomic counting histogram separates commutativity; loop counts are exactly 1,4,36,576,14400. A concrete pair on six elements is verified to be commuting versus noncommuting while all its vertices share an identical atomic two-type histogram in both structures; the one-class equitable partition proves complete C2 equivalence. At n=6, conjugacy reduction by C_{S6}(f) covers all eleven cycle types, all 7920 reduced presentations, 901 simultaneous-conjugacy types and exactly three mixed full C2 stable-equivalence classes with numbers (4,3),(2,2),(2,2). A separate C++ enumeration directly inspects all 518400 labelled pairs and corroborates 860 stable signatures and precisely three mixed signatures. The included source code and output records have been executed and compared. The proof of finite exhaustiveness and the binary-structure C2/colour-refinement equivalence are explicit; no infinite inference is claimed.

originality.rationale: The precise object is an ordered pair of relational permutation graphs and the precise conclusion is a six-point minimal C2-indistinguishability threshold plus three mixed minimum-order C2 equivalence classes. Inspected published work on C2 gives foundational equivalence rather than this threshold; work on k-commuting permutations addresses Hamming composition distance, not logical equivalence; work on permutation FO treats different encodings. A previous statement on commuting-pair C2 collisions restrict to pairs satisfying commutation and hence cannot imply a commute-versus-noncommute ambiguity. Actual literature and semantic-research searches located no prior identical/dominating theorem; this is qualified originality with specialized-coverage risk.
residual_risks: Unindexed prior specialized work might already report the minimal C2 commutativity ambiguity in relational permutation pairs.
Full classification is proved only at the first obstruction order six; nothing is claimed for the distribution of ambiguities in larger structures.
This is self-review and not independent scientific or publication-priority certification.

value.rationale: A two-variable counting fragment is a well-established and mathematically motivated expressibility boundary, while commutativity of two named permutations is a basic algebraic property. The exact least size at which that property escapes C2, three complete distinct minimal ambiguity mechanisms and 3-variable definability form a natural complete finite classification of a logical threshold, not a recreational arbitrary-size census. Full low-order coverage and an explicit obstruction answer both positive and negative sides of a precise question; larger-order classification is not needed for this first-obstruction value.
